# stripe

**Tag**: web, networking

## 简介

Stripe is the easiest way to accept payments online.  See https://stripe.com for details.

## 官网

- 主页: https://stripe.com/docs/api?lang=ruby
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/stripe/stripe-ruby
- 更新日志: https://github.com/stripe/stripe-ruby/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/stripe/stripe-ruby/issues
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/stripe
